brollSetting: Set in a real Indian legal setting: real Indian people in ordinary modern clothing, real Indian courthouse, government office and small-town locations. Documentary realism, no animation, no cartoon, no illustration, no 3D render.

globalStyle.voice: @me verified avatar voice (identical pitch, tone, accent in every clip)
globalStyle.outfit: crisp white shirt and black blazer (identical in every scene)
globalStyle.background: the same private office with deep forest-green panelled walls, a framed botanical print, a tall plant and a walnut bookshelf — but almost entirely swallowed by darkness, only the faintest gold edge catching one line of panelling, identical in every scene
globalStyle.gestures: Seated upright and still, well back from the camera, forearms resting on the desk with small restrained gestures, he stays seated throughout
globalStyle.audio: @me verified avatar voice ONLY, continuous speech filling the full 10 seconds at a brisk explainer pace, NO background music, NO silence at start or end
globalStyle.negativePrompts: He stays seated behind the desk, set well back from camera; the image stays very dark and high contrast with one side of his face in darkness. NO lamp, NO light fixture, NO studio light, NO softbox, NO light stand, NO spotlight, NO visible light source of any kind anywhere in the frame; NO fill light, NO second light, NO soft even illumination, NO flat lighting, NO daylight, NO brightly lit background, NO evenly lit face; NO gap beneath the desk, NO table legs, NO chair legs, NO floor visible; nothing in his hands; NO text, NO captions, NO logos, NO outfit change, NO camera cut, NO standing up
globalStyle.camera: Locked-off static shot, landscape 16:9. He is SEATED well back behind a large solid walnut desk so there is clear space between him and the camera and the dark room is visible around and behind him — a wider shot, not a close-up. Framed from the waist up, small in frame, with the desk running across the bottom; the desk front is solid so no gap, no table legs, no chair legs and no floor are visible. Eye level, 50mm lens look, no zoom, no pan, no camera movement
globalStyle.realism: Photorealistic film-noir footage, extreme chiaroscuro. The left side of his face and his left shoulder glow warm gold, while the right side of his face and body fall into complete darkness with no detail at all. The room behind him is almost entirely black; only a faint gold edge traces one line of wall panelling and the near edge of the desk. Fine golden dust motes drift slowly in the air. Deeply crushed blacks, very high contrast, no fill of any kind, roughly eighty percent of the frame is pure black. Natural skin texture, accurate lip sync, identical exposure in every scene
globalStyle.delivery: Energetic educational explainer style, like a confident teacher: brisk pace, continuous speech, no long pauses, natural emphasis on key words; speak the dialogue exactly once, word for word, never repeat, stretch or slow down a word

scenes.visual3D: Ravishankar seated well back behind the walnut desk in a nearly black room, the left side of his face glowing warm gold and the right side lost in darkness, speaking to camera, same framing in every clip, no props, no visible lamps, no text.
scenes.dialogue: A man in Bengaluru complained about a civic amenity site allotment. He went to the police, to the Lokayukta, even to the Governor. Nobody acted.

scenes.visual3D: Ravishankar seated well back behind the walnut desk in a nearly black room, the left side of his face glowing warm gold and the right side lost in darkness, speaking to camera, same framing in every clip, no props, no visible lamps, no text.
scenes.dialogue: So he filed a private complaint before a Magistrate. But the trial court found an unverified affidavit, and diverted the case into a Section two twenty three enquiry.

scenes.visual3D: Ravishankar seated well back behind the walnut desk in a nearly black room, the left side of his face glowing warm gold and the right side lost in darkness, speaking to camera, same framing in every clip, no props, no visible lamps, no text.
scenes.dialogue: The ruling went the other way. An unverified affidavit is a curable defect, not a fatal one. It cannot end a complaint before that complaint has even begun.
